title: JSON API: handovers and returns
interface: Blueprint `bp` (name 'api_handovers'; mounted at /api/v1). All routes require api_auth_required. GET /handovers?status=&kind= -> 200 list of handovers with 'asset' and 'employee' details (service.with_details). POST /handovers JSON {asset_id, employee_email, note?} -> 201 handover dict; unknown employee -> 404 {'error'}; HandoverError -> 409 {'error'}; missing fields -> 400. GET /handovers/<int:id> -> 200 with details | 404. POST /handovers/<int:id>/cancel -> 200 | 409 (HandoverError) | 404. GET /handovers/<int:id>/protocol.pdf -> the stored PDF (send_file, mimetype application/pdf) | 404 when none. POST /returns JSON {asset_id, note?} -> 201 handover dict | 409 | 400. Use src/services/factory.py build_handover_service(db) to construct the service.
